headline: Council motions on Woburn Street parking, school bus cameras, 2027 paving plans, and a Lowell Housing Authority land restriction release vote.
summary: The council will consider several member motions on traffic safety, building permit access, school bus cameras, and street paving plans, plus city manager reports on vacancy ordinance, short-term rentals, the reservoir, and social districts. The council will also vote on releasing land restrictions for the Lowell Housing Authority and hear committee reports.
items: Motion to develop real-time public access to search building permits
Motion for traffic safety plan on Woburn Street, including possible parking prohibition at 178–194 Woburn Street
Motion for report on new Mini Forest and Pollinator Garden in Centralville
Motion for report on pilot camera program for school buses
Motion for 2027 street and sidewalk paving and traffic calming plans
Motion for report on costs and benefits of fire department response to non-fire calls, including EMS and helipad calls
Motion for traffic engineer to monitor Beacon Street congestion near Robinson School and consider signage or crossing guard
Communication on resignations of members from various boards and commissions
Communication on appointment of Olivia Hart-Paulson to Commission on Disability
Vote to authorize City Manager to execute release of land restrictions for Lowell Housing Authority
Report from Rules & Election Law Subcommittee, October 6, 2026
location: City Council Chamber, 375 Merrimack Street, 2nd Floor, Lowell, MA / Zoom (Hybrid)

Minutes Of Rules & Election Law SC October 6th; City Council Regular Meeting 
October 6th, For Acceptance.
2026 OCTOBER 6 RULES ELECTION LAW SC MINUTES.PDF
2026 OCTOBER 6 CC MINUTES.PDF
CITY COUNCIL - MOTIONS
C. Scott - Req. City Mgr. Work With The Appropriate Department To Develop And 
Implement A System That Provides The Public With Real-Time Access To Search For 
Building Permits As They Are Issued. 
C. Scott - Req. City Mgr. Work With The Traffic Engineer To Develop A Plan To 
Improve Safety Along Woburn Street, Including Evaluating The Prohibition Of On-
Street Vehicle Parking Along 178–194 Woburn Street To Improve Sight Lines And 
Visibility For Pedestrians And Motorists.
C. Robinson - Req. City Mgr. Have The Proper Department Provide A Report On The 
Newly Installed Mini Forest As Well As The Pollinator Garden In Centralville.
C. Robinson / C. Descoteaux - Req. City Mgr. Have The Proper Department Provide 
A Report Providing A Path Forward To Implement A Pilot Camera Program On A 
Selection Of School Buses Assigned To Transporting Lowell Students.
C. Juran - Req. City Mgr. Have DPW And Transportation Engineer Prepare, By Early 
2027 Or As Appropriate, Plans For Which Streets And Sidewalks Will Be Paved, 
Otherwise Repaired, Or Traffic Calmed In 2027 And How Consistent The Prioritization 
Is With The Decision Flow-Charts.
C. Juran - Req. City Mgr. Have Proper Departments Explain Benefits And Costs Of 
Having Firefighters And Fire Trucks Respond To Non-Fire Calls (Including EMS And 
Helipad Calls) And The Costs And Feasibility Of Alternatives.
M. Gitschier - Req. City Mgr. Have The Traffic Engineer Monitor The Traffic Being Held 
Back On Beacon Street From 9:05 To 9:30am And Again At The Robinson School 
Dismissal Between 2:05 And 2:25pm; There Is Also A Need For Clearer Signage Or 
A Trained Crossing Guard During These Heavy Traffic Times.
